steps.text: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Spray 9x13 inch baking pan with cooking spray.

Combine Parmesan cheese, dry bread crumbs, oregano, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper in a shallow bowl. Dip chicken breasts into melted margarine, then coat with bread crumb mixture. Place in prepared pan.

Bake in preheated oven until chicken breasts are no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 20 to 25 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

raw_recipe.description: A baked Parmesan chicken that is super easy to prepare.

review.reviewBody: This dish was awesome! Cooked the chicken exactly as directed. Made a sauce using 2 minced garlic cloves and 1 diced white onion sauteed in olive oil, a can of italian stewed tomatoes (undrained) and a little tomato paste. Let that thicken up and spooned over the chicken when it came out of the oven. Topped with shredded mozarella and baked about 5 min longer, until cheese melted. Served over spaghetti tossed with olive oil, salt and pepper! This will be a regular in our house. Simple and Delicious! Thanks for sharing!:)

This dish has become a weekly standard at our house since finding it on here. We often substitute regular salt for garlic salt to add a bit more of a kick. And we always serve on a bed of fettuccine pasta, and (when in season) cooked zucchini on the side. Got extra coating left over? we cook it, flake it out, and its a great topping to add a bit of extra jazz to the pasta.

I melted Smart Balance in an oven-proof skillet, added chicken tenderloins to coat,removed the tenderloins and added them to a gallon storage bag containing the coating, put them back in the skillet and popped them in the oven for 14 minutes. This was very good and I only used one pan!! All three of my young children asked for seconds-really that says enough.

I bought one large chicken breast and cut it into three even slices. I used 2 rounded tablespoons Panko, 2 tablespoons parmesan, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper and 2 tablespoons butter. I really coated the chicken with the bread crumbs (multiple times and pressed it on). I baked it at 450 for about 30 minutes or until it was golden. Husband loved it! :)

Grandma Bogie's Parmesan Chicken Haiku: "Not enough bread crumbs, and too much parmesan cheese. Should've read reviews." This was pretty good chicken - put mine on a foil-lined rack so the bottom of the chicken would have the change to get crispy too, rather than sitting straight on a baking pan, soggifying. Could benefit from some garlic powder, or garlic salt, but overall taste was nice, and texture was moist; just not thrilled w/ the 2:1 cheese-to-crumb ratio.

I was looking for an easy chicken parmesan recipe and this one worked well. It's good and cook time of 20 minutes was perfect. 2 Tablespoons melted butter was perfect for the 4 breast halves I had. For Gluten Free, I used GF Italian Seasoned bread crumbs. As others have noted, there isn't enough bread crumbs. I ended up adding more (1:1 ratio bread crumbs:parmesan cheese). Topped with a little marinara sauce and mozzarella cheese in the last 5 minutes of cooking for my husband and served with spaghetti. Overall, a good recipe that is quick to prepare, but some minor changes are needed for the amount of bread crumbs you will need. Thanks for the recipe!
This had great flavor and crispness for being baked in the oven. Doubled the Parmesan.

I did not have breadcrumbs, so I crushed up some pretzels instead. This was amazing & the chicken came out so juicy & cut like butter. I had to recommend it to my family because I knew they would like it too.
I made this but added 1tablespoon of lemon pepper, 1/4 tsp cayenne and fresh parsley as well as some garlic powder! It was good! My boyfriend had seconds. :)

Great basic recipe! I made a few tweaks to suit our preferences (and what we had on hand!) and did the following. First, I pounded the chicken breast to about 1/4 inch to reduce cooking time. For the breading, I used Panko bread crumbs, eliminated the oregano and paprika, and added some basil, marjoram, and garlic. Fabulous taste, fabulous crunch, and it is now part of our regular rotation. Thanks for a great recipe!!

I made this as written. Will use freshly grated Parmesan cheese next time for even more flavor. I love this easy delicious recipe that kept the moisture in the chicken breast. I used individually packaged chicken so it was super easy. My hubby only eats fish and chicken so it was great finding a new recipe.
A wonderful blend of flavors. This will be be one I will fix often.

Great chicken recipe! The spices are spot on and the butter flavor is so good. My oven cooks a bit hot, so I cut the cook time to 16-17 mins. and it was perfectly cooked. Crisp on the outside and juicy on the inside. Thanks so much for submitting this easy and delicious recipe!
Really good flavor. One of the best chicken recipes I've tried! I'll definitely be making again

This recipe is sooo simple & delicious! I make it exactly as written except for using butter instead of margarine. It's become my favorite recipe for boneless, skinless chicken thighs, which we prefer over breasts. Moist inside with a yummy, crunchy coating.
So good! Crispy outside, tender inside. Great recipe, thank you!!

This came out delicious! Ended up taking 35 minutes in the oven for me, but other than that I followed the recipe and the chicken had a great flavor. Served with a side of spaghetti with tomato sauce and garlic bread - everyone enjoyed.
Love it! Absolutely perfect, and a fan favorite! Will definitely be making again!
I make this as the recipe states. It is delicious. My entire family loves it. I never have leftovers. Great recipe.
Chicken was easy to make and very testy. I actually followed AmyLee’s review. My family said this us a do over! Nice to have a new recipe for boneless chicken breasts.
